title: Revisiting the 16x Pretraining Compute Gap between Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.17590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have attracted wide attention for their fast, parallel decoding, but they are believed to be far less efficient to train than autoregressive language models (ARMs): a widely cited study reports that a DLM needs roughly 16x the training compute of an ARM to match its likelihood, a figure that has made pretraining DLMs from scratch look prohibitive at scale. We find that the methodology behind this figure has fallen out of step with current DLM practice: it scores the model with its evidence lower bound (ELBO) and trains a full-sequence, decoder-only model. We therefore revisit the scaling laws of DLMs, adopting the exact likelihood under the model's own decoding order, block diffusion training, an encoder-decoder architecture, and a sweep over the block sizes used in practice. translated_title: 重新审视扩散语言模型与自回归语言模型之间16倍的预训练计算差距
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型因其快速、并行的解码能力而受到广泛关注，但人们普遍认为其训练效率远低于自回归语言模型（ARMs）：一项被广泛引用的研究报告指出，扩散语言模型需要大约16倍于自回归模型的训练计算量才能达到相同的似然水平，这一数字使得从零开始预训练扩散语言模型在大规模应用上显得望而却步。我们发现，这一数字背后的研究方法已经与当前扩散语言模型的实践脱节：它使用证据下界（ELBO）来评估模型，并训练全序列的仅解码器模型。因此，我们重新审视了扩散语言模型的缩放定律，采用了模型自身解码顺序下的精确似然、块扩散训练、编码器-解码器架构，并对实践中使用的块大小进行了扫描。在这一新协议下，我们研究了十个模型变体、总计约1700个模型，发现预训练扩散语言模型的计算成本远……
tldr: 本研究采用现代扩散语言模型训练实践（精确似然评估、块扩散训练、编码器-解码器架构）重新审视扩散语言模型的缩放定律，通过约1700个模型的大规模实验发现，扩散语言模型与自回归语言模型之间所谓的16倍预训练计算差距远小于此前声称的水平。
en_tdlr: By revisiting diffusion language model scaling laws under modern training practices (exact likelihood, block diffusion training, and encoder-decoder architecture) across ~1,700 models in ten variants, this paper finds that the widely cited 16x pretraining compute gap over autoregressive language models is far smaller than previously claimed.
